title: ACM Hub Validation
description: Production readiness checklist of the ACM hub (local-cluster), from fleet-validator.

panels.title: Production ready
panels.description: READY when no critical check fails.

panels.title: Skipped
panels.description: Not applicable or no data (API not installed, probe policy not placed). Not scored.

panels.title: Platform checks
panels.description: OpenShift baseline: ClusterVersion, ClusterOperators, MachineConfigPools, nodes, CSRs, etcd, API latency.

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="Platform"})

panels.title: ACM Hub checks
panels.description: MultiClusterHub / MultiClusterEngine health, ACM operator CSV and hub pods.

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="ACM Hub"})
max by (check, detail) (fleetvalidator_check_detail{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="ACM Hub"})

panels.title: Backup & DR checks
panels.description: cluster-backup, OADP, BackupStorageLocation, BackupSchedule and the backup-restore-enabled policy.

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="Backup & DR"})
max by (check, detail) (fleetvalidator_check_detail{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="Backup & DR"})

panels.title: Observability checks
panels.description: MultiClusterObservability, observability pods and User Workload Monitoring.

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="Observability"})

panels.title: Governance checks
panels.description: Policies placed on the cluster: minimum OperatorPolicies / ConfigurationPolicies, all Compliant.

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="Governance"})

panels.title: GitOps checks
panels.description: Argo CD instances and Applications (the hub GitOps loop).

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="GitOps"})

panels.title: Fleet checks
panels.description: Hub view of every ManagedCluster, local-cluster add-ons and fleet-wide policy compliance.

targets.expr: max by (check, title, severity) (fleetvalidator_check_state{managed_cluster="$hub", cluster_type="hub", group="Fleet"})

panels.title: Managed clusters
panels.description: Every validated managed cluster. Open one in the Managed Cluster Validation dashboard.
